# - Significance level: α = 0.05

sd <- 0.5
alpha <- 0.05

alt_mean <- null_mean + effect_size

# - Sample size: n = 25
# - Standard deviation: σ = 0.5
# - Significance level: α = 0.05

library(stats)

n <- 25

sd <- 0.5
alpha <- 0.05
null_mean <- 0
alt_mean <- null_mean + effect_size

# Standardized effect size (Cohen's d)

alt_mean <- null_mean + effect_size

# Standardized effect size (Cohen's d)

cat("Study Design Parameters:\n")

cat(sprintf("Cohen's d: %.2f\n", cohens_d))
cat(sprintf("Significance level (α): %.4f\n", alpha))

cat("\n")

# Non-centrality parameter for t-distribution

cat(sprintf("Non-centrality parameter (λ): %.6f\n", ncp))

# Degrees of freedom
